question: With the exact same identifying-predicate and policy experience multiset, does separating the two primitives into homogeneous gradient-accumulation windows improve two-sided predicate acquisition and/or zero-shot composition relative to mixing both primitives inside every optimizer window?
causal_variable: optimizer-visible primitive co-mixing inside a gradient-accumulation window

LOCAL_MIXED.window_contract: 18 accumulation windows per epoch; each window contains exactly 4 identifying-predicate rows and 4 policy rows
LOCAL_MIXED.interpretation: replicates the v1.2 local mixed primitive geometry on fresh seeds

WINDOW_SEPARATED.window_contract: 18 accumulation windows per epoch; 9 windows contain 8 identifying-predicate rows and 9 contain 8 policy rows; predicate/policy window types alternate under a frozen seed-dependent start order
WINDOW_SEPARATED.interpretation: removes within-update primitive co-mixing while preserving the complete experience multiset

requires_all: mean paired WINDOW_SEPARATED minus LOCAL_MIXED predicate balanced-accuracy delta > 0
WINDOW_SEPARATED wins predicate balanced accuracy on at least 4 of 6 paired seeds
pooled predicate false-truth accuracy is not lower in WINDOW_SEPARATED
pooled predicate true-truth accuracy is not lower in WINDOW_SEPARATED
mean POLICY_DIRECT accuracy >= 0.95 in both arms

trigger_any: WINDOW_SEPARATED wins fewer than 4 of 6 paired seeds
the apparent predicate gain is produced by improving one truth side while materially harming the other

requires_all: at least 4 of 6 WINDOW_SEPARATED seeds have false-truth accuracy >= 0.65
at least 4 of 6 WINDOW_SEPARATED seeds have true-truth accuracy >= 0.65
at least 4 of 6 WINDOW_SEPARATED seeds have direct-predicate overall accuracy >= 0.75

INTERFERENCE_HELPED_BUT_COMPOSITION_DID_.trigger: LOCAL_INTERFERENCE_SUPPORTED is true but mean paired composed-action delta <= 0 or WINDOW_SEPARATED wins composed action on fewer than 4 of 6 seeds
INTERFERENCE_HELPED_BUT_COMPOSITION_DID_.disposition: raise primitive-interface / learner-decomposition mismatch; do not claim composition law

requires_all: WINDOW_SEPARATED wins composed action on at least 4 of 6 seeds
pooled composed false-truth accuracy is not lower
pooled composed true-truth accuracy is not lower
INTERFERENCE_AND_COMPOSITION_SUPPORTED.disposition: replicate transport effect before any broader promotion

preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_IF_INTERFERENCE_WEAKENED: run the preregistered dose/horizon discriminator on the predicate primitive; do not keep rearranging windows
preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_IF_INTERFERENCE_SUPPORTED_WITHOUT_C: test the declared primitive interface / recruitment mechanism directly
preregistered_dispositions.NEXT_IF_INTERFERENCE_AND_COMPOSITION_SUP: fresh-domain replication of the optimizer-transport construction law before broader CFE claims

hard_prohibitions: No change to predicate or policy experience content between arms.
No change to evaluation prompts or expected outputs.
No adaptive seed extension beyond six frozen seeds.
No post-outcome schedule, threshold, optimizer, profile, or support edits.
No K-dose or primitive-interface scientific screen in parallel.
No use of v1.2 mixed-arm outcomes as the v1.3 control; both v1.3 arms must run on fresh paired seeds.
No promotion from an optimizer-transport result to Developmental CFE without a separate developmental ecology experiment.
evidence_ceiling: This screen can establish or weaken a local optimizer-visible primitive-interference mechanism under the fixed CapybaraHermes/Mistral learner and current factorized interface. It cannot prove a universal CFE law or Microseed applicability.
